name: Windows EXE

on:
  push:

      - main

concurrency:
  group: pc-health-check-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}

env:
  DOTNET_NOLOGO: 'true'
  DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT: 'true'

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 1

      - name: E2E PowerShell tools smoke
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          $scripts = Get-ChildItem tools/e2e -Filter *.ps1 -File
          if ($scripts.Count -lt 5) { throw "Expected at least 5 E2E PowerShell tools, found $($scripts.Count)." }

          foreach ($script in $scripts) {
            $tokens = $null
            $parseErrors = $null
            [void][System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile($script.FullName, [ref]$tokens, [ref]$parseErrors)
            if (@($parseErrors).Count -gt 0) {
              $details = @($parseErrors) | ForEach-Object { "$($_.Extent.StartLineNumber):$($_.Extent.StartColumnNumber) $($_.Message)" }
              throw "PowerShell parse errors in $($script.Name): $($details -join ' | ')"
            }
          }
          Write-Host "PowerShell parser gate passed for $($scripts.Count) scripts."

          try {
            & pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -File .\tools\e2e\Prepare-CleanTempScenario.ps1
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Prepare-CleanTempScenario failed with exit code $LASTEXITCODE" }

            $root = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'GPcHealthCheck-E2E'
            $old = Join-Path $root 'old-delete-me.txt'
            $fresh = Join-Path $root 'fresh-must-stay.txt'
            $manifest = Join-Path $root 'e2e-manifest.json'
            if (-not (Test-Path $old) -or -not (Test-Path $fresh) -or -not (Test-Path $manifest)) {
              throw 'Prepare scenario did not create all required sentinels/manifest.'
            }

            # Simulate only the observable effect of successful CleanTemp on our dedicated old sentinel.
            # The real application's remediation is deliberately not invoked against the shared runner Temp.
            Remove-Item -LiteralPath $old -Force
            & pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -File .\tools\e2e\Verify-CleanTempScenario.ps1
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Verify-CleanTempScenario failed with exit code $LASTEXITCODE" }

            $evidenceOut = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'gpchc-e2e-evidence'
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $evidenceOut | Out-Null
            & pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -File .\tools\e2e\Collect-E2EEvidence.ps1 -OutputDirectory $evidenceOut -LatestReportFiles 2
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Collect-E2EEvidence failed with exit code $LASTEXITCODE" }
            $zip = Get-ChildItem $evidenceOut -Filter 'G-PC-Health-E2E-*.zip' -File | Select-Object -First 1
            if ($null -eq $zip -or $zip.Length -le 0) { throw 'Evidence collector did not create a non-empty ZIP.' }
          }
          finally {
            & pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -File .\tools\e2e\Cleanup-E2EScenario.ps1
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Cleanup-E2EScenario failed with exit code $LASTEXITCODE" }
            if (Test-Path (Join-Path $env:TEMP 'GPcHealthCheck-E2E')) { throw 'E2E Temp root remains after cleanup.' }
          }

          Write-Host 'E2E PowerShell tools smoke passed.'

      - name: PowerShell parser gates
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $targets = @(
            '.\tools\ci\Create-PilotBundle.ps1',
            '.\tools\ci\Test-PortableWorker.ps1',
            '.\tools\branding\Generate-BrandAssets.ps1'
          )
          foreach ($target in $targets) {
            $tokens = $null
            $parseErrors = $null
            [void][System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile((Resolve-Path $target).Path, [ref]$tokens, [ref]$parseErrors)
            if (@($parseErrors).Count -gt 0) {
              $details = @($parseErrors) | ForEach-Object { "$($_.Extent.StartLineNumber):$($_.Extent.StartColumnNumber) $($_.Message)" }
              throw "PowerShell parse errors in ${target}: $($details -join ' | ')"
            }
          }

      - name: Generate and verify brand assets
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          .\tools\branding\Generate-BrandAssets.ps1
          $shield = '.\src\G.PcHealthCheck\assets\g-shield.png'
          $icon = '.\src\G.PcHealthCheck\assets\gpchc.ico'
          $shieldHash = (Get-FileHash $shield -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
          if ($shieldHash -ne '5157c5cf83a6cfddb74c51701a693e401e36b400812505a1e46e15d760c72877') {
            throw "Corporate shield provenance mismatch: $shieldHash"
          }
          if ((Get-Item $icon).Length -lt 4096) { throw 'Generated application icon is unexpectedly small.' }
          Write-Host "Corporate G-switcher shield verified: $shieldHash"

      - name: Setup .NET 8
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@67a3573c9a986a3f9c594539f4ab511d57bb3ce9 # v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '8.0.425'

      - name: Restore
        run: dotnet restore src/G.PcHealthCheck/G.PcHealthCheck.csproj

      - name: NuGet vulnerability gate
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $output = dotnet list src/G.PcHealthCheck/G.PcHealthCheck.csproj package --vulnerable --include-transitive --format json
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "NuGet vulnerability audit command failed with exit code $LASTEXITCODE" }
          $audit = ($output -join "`n") | ConvertFrom-Json
          $vulnerable = @()
          foreach ($project in @($audit.projects)) {
            foreach ($framework in @($project.frameworks)) {
              foreach ($package in @($framework.topLevelPackages) + @($framework.transitivePackages)) {
                if ($null -ne $package -and @($package.vulnerabilities).Count -gt 0) {
                  $vulnerable += $package
                }
              }
            }
          }
          if ($vulnerable.Count -gt 0) {
            $names = $vulnerable | ForEach-Object { "$($_.id) $($_.resolvedVersion)" }
            throw "Vulnerable NuGet packages detected: $($names -join ', ')"
          }
          Write-Host "NuGet vulnerability gate: no known vulnerable packages."

      - name: Build
        run: dotnet build src/G.PcHealthCheck/G.PcHealthCheck.csproj -c Release --no-restore -warnaserror

      - name: Source-build self-test
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          dotnet run --project src/G.PcHealthCheck/G.PcHealthCheck.csproj -c Release --no-build -- --selftest
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Source-build self-test failed with exit code $LASTEXITCODE" }

      - name: Publish single EXE
        run: dotnet publish src/G.PcHealthCheck/G.PcHealthCheck.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true --no-restore -o artifacts/publish

      - name: Published EXE self-test
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $exe = (Resolve-Path artifacts/publish/G-PC-Health.exe).Path
          $process = Start-Process -FilePath $exe -ArgumentList @('--selftest') -Wait -PassThru
          if ($process.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "Published single-file EXE self-test failed with exit code $($process.ExitCode)" }
          Write-Host "Published single-file EXE self-test passed."

      - name: Published portable worker and security negative tests
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          .\tools\ci\Test-PortableWorker.ps1 -ExePath .\artifacts\publish\G-PC-Health.exe

      - name: Verify package, version and checksum
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $exe = Get-Item artifacts/publish/G-PC-Health.exe -ErrorAction Stop
          $unexpected = Get-ChildItem artifacts/publish -File | Where-Object Name -ne 'G-PC-Health.exe'
          if ($unexpected) { throw "Single-file gate failed: $($unexpected.Name -join ', ')" }

          [xml]$project = Get-Content src/G.PcHealthCheck/G.PcHealthCheck.csproj
          $projectVersion = [string]$project.Project.PropertyGroup.Version
          $actualFileVersion = [Version][System.Diagnostics.FileVersionInfo]::GetVersionInfo($exe.FullName).FileVersion
          if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($projectVersion)) { throw 'Project Version is empty.' }
          $expectedFileVersion = [Version]::Parse("$projectVersion.0")
          if ($actualFileVersion -ne $expectedFileVersion) {
            throw "File version mismatch. Expected=$expectedFileVersion EXE=$actualFileVersion"
          }

          $hash = (Get-FileHash $exe.FullName -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
          New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force artifacts/final | Out-Null
          Copy-Item $exe.FullName artifacts/final/G-PC-Health.exe
          Set-Content artifacts/final/G-PC-Health.exe.sha256 "$hash  G-PC-Health.exe" -Encoding ascii
          Write-Host "Version: $actualFileVersion"
          Write-Host "SHA-256: $hash"

      - name: Create and verify pilot bundle
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          .\tools\ci\Create-PilotBundle.ps1 `
            -ExePath .\artifacts\final\G-PC-Health.exe `
            -ChecksumPath .\artifacts\final\G-PC-Health.exe.sha256 `
            -OutputDirectory .\artifacts\pilot `
            -GitSha $env:GITHUB_SHA

          $pilotZip = Get-ChildItem .\artifacts\pilot -Filter 'G-PC-Health-*-pilot.zip' -File | Select-Object -First 1
          if ($null -eq $pilotZip -or $pilotZip.Length -le 0) { throw 'Pilot bundle ZIP missing or empty.' }

          $verify = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'gpchc-pilot-verify'
          Remove-Item $verify -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
          New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $verify | Out-Null
          Expand-Archive -LiteralPath $pilotZip.FullName -DestinationPath $verify -Force

          $manifest = Get-Content (Join-Path $verify 'package-manifest.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
          $packagedExe = Join-Path $verify 'G-PC-Health.exe'
          if (-not (Test-Path $packagedExe -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'Packaged EXE missing.' }
          $packagedHash = (Get-FileHash $packagedExe -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
          if ($packagedHash -ne [string]$manifest.sha256) { throw 'Packaged EXE hash does not match package manifest.' }
          if ([string]$manifest.gitSha -ne $env:GITHUB_SHA) { throw 'Package manifest Git SHA mismatch.' }
          if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $verify 'START-HERE.txt'))) { throw 'START-HERE.txt missing.' }
          if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $verify 'docs\E2E-TEST-PLAN.md'))) { throw 'E2E test plan missing.' }
          if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $verify 'e2e\Analyze-E2EEvidence.ps1'))) { throw 'Evidence analyzer missing.' }
          $toolCount = @(Get-ChildItem (Join-Path $verify 'e2e') -Filter '*.ps1' -File).Count
          if ($toolCount -lt 5) { throw "Expected at least 5 E2E tools in pilot bundle, found $toolCount." }
          $strictUtf8Bom = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($true, $true)
          $startHereText = [IO.File]::ReadAllText((Join-Path $verify 'START-HERE.txt'), $strictUtf8Bom)
          if (-not $startHereText.Contains('Сверьте SHA-256') -or -not $startHereText.Contains('Диагностику можно запускать')) {
            throw 'Packaged START-HERE strict UTF-8 verification failed.'
          }
          if ($manifest.trustedRemediationPath -ne $null -or -not $manifest.portableElevation -or $manifest.executableNameRestricted) {

          }
          Write-Host "Pilot bundle verified: $($pilotZip.Name)"

Семь metrics адаптируются к ширине, security coverage всегда доступна, RAM warning понятен. Splitter пропорциональный с минимумами обеих панелей. Typed Unknown reasons: RightsRequired, SourceUnavailable, Timeout, QueryError, PolicyMissing, UnsupportedField, SourceConflict. Cancellation отдельно от причины Unknown; partial facts сохраняются. BitLocker: убрать EncryptionPercentage из WMI SELECT, получать progress через GetConversionStatus; сохранять return code и права. ProtectionStatus отдельно от progress. Ошибка progress не удаляет успешно собранную protection evidence.

Детерминированные clock/source fixtures, UI/report parity и сохранение read-only boundaries.

SecurityPostureEvaluator.cs уже считает known-subset score/coverage и AssessmentIncomplete при coverage<80. SecurityPostureModels.cs уже разделяет snapshot/assessment, но SecurityEvidence содержит только Key/Value/Source — новые typed reasons/time/exit metadata нужны.

Существуют перечисленные шесть диагностических модулей и их selftests. PerformanceSessionCore уже имеет duration/interval bounds, cancellation и completeness. Новое: summary navigation, event grouping semantics, contributor presentation и versioned cross-snapshot delta. Наличие модулей не доказывает выполнение всей новой acceptance matrix.

Четыре новые необходимые Windows test artifact cycles планируются, не запускаются. Существующий ledger/task/events/outcomes не обнулять. Hosted Windows не означает real Windows11 GUI/UAC/RDP acceptance. Merge/main/production release только после real Windows11 pilot и explicit owner integration approval. Watchdog остаётся paused.

def check(journal, adapter_bytes, ledger, lease, source, *, admission=None):

    if journal.get('qualified_quality') != 'ACCEPTED' or journal.get('root_activation') != 'APPROVED':
        raise ValueError('launch denied: qualified review/root activation missing')
    if hashlib.sha256(adapter_bytes).hexdigest() != journal['selected_adapter_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('launch denied: selected adapter bytes mismatch')
    adapter = yaml.load(adapter_bytes.decode(), Loader=StrictLoader)
    if digest(adapter) != journal['selected_adapter_semantic_digest']:
        raise ValueError('launch denied: adapter semantic digest mismatch')
    budget.validate_ledger(ledger)
    execution_lease_v2.validate(lease)
    if adapter['orchestration']['budget'] != ledger['policy']:
        raise ValueError('launch denied: adapter/current ledger policy mismatch')
    if ledger['policy_digest'] != journal['new_budget_digest']:

    if source != journal['source']:

    resolved = {r['grant_id'] for r in lease['submission_resolutions']}
    if lease['external_guard'] is not None or any(c['grant_id'] not in resolved for c in lease['submission_claims']):
        raise ValueError('launch denied: boundary is guarded/pending')
    admission = admission or {'role': 'writer'}
    if admission.get('role') == 'writer':

        encoded = json.dumps(approved, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')).encode()

def run(repo_host, journal_store, adapter_path, *, review_binding=None):

    revision, journal = journal_store.read()

    adapter_path = Path(adapter_path)
    argv = [sys.executable, '-B', S + '/validate_adapter.py', str(adapter_path)]
    result = subprocess.run(argv, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
    if result.returncode:
        raise ValueError('launch denied: strict adapter validator rejected selection')

def check(journal, adapter_bytes, ledger, lease, source, *, admission=None):
    if journal.get('state') != 'ACTIVE' or journal.get('policy_activated') is not True:
        raise ValueError('launch denied: migration is not ACTIVE')
    if journal.get('qualified_quality') != 'ACCEPTED' or journal.get('root_activation') != 'APPROVED':
        raise ValueError('launch denied: qualified review/root activation missing')
    if hashlib.sha256(adapter_bytes).hexdigest() != journal['selected_adapter_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('launch denied: selected adapter bytes mismatch')
    adapter = yaml.load(adapter_bytes.decode(), Loader=StrictLoader)
    if digest(adapter) != journal['selected_adapter_semantic_digest']:
        raise ValueError('launch denied: adapter semantic digest mismatch')
    budget.validate_ledger(ledger)
    execution_lease_v2.validate(lease)
    if adapter['orchestration']['budget'] != ledger['policy']:
        raise ValueError('launch denied: adapter/current ledger policy mismatch')
    if ledger['policy_digest'] != journal['new_budget_digest']:
        raise ValueError('launch denied: current budget digest mismatch')
    if source != journal['source']:
        raise ValueError('launch denied: fresh source mismatch')
    resolved = {r['grant_id'] for r in lease['submission_resolutions']}
    if lease['external_guard'] is not None or any(c['grant_id'] not in resolved for c in lease['submission_claims']):

    if admission.get('role') == 'writer':
        if lease['owner_id'] is not None or lease['invocation'] is not None:
            raise ValueError('launch denied: writer requires released boundary')

        if (admission.get('purpose') != 'exact_candidate_quality'
                or admission.get('candidate_sha') != journal.get('review_candidate_sha')
                or admission.get('candidate_sha') != admission.get('observed_candidate_sha')

                or lease['owner_id'] is None

                or admission.get('parent_scope') != 'writer'):

def run(repo_host, journal_store, adapter_path, *, review_binding=None):
    """Actual fresh readback route, to be invoked at every future launch boundary."""
    revision, journal = journal_store.read()

        raise ValueError('launch denied: durable journal missing')
    adapter_path = Path(adapter_path)
    argv = [sys.executable, '-B', S + '/validate_adapter.py', str(adapter_path)]
